account_custom_field_help.limit_by_accounts: Only export hosts coming from these source accounts, comma separated. A name prefixed with ! excludes that account instead. Empty exports the hosts of every account.
account_custom_field_help.limit_by_hostnames: Only export these hosts, comma separated — for trying an export out on a few hosts. Empty exports every host.
account_custom_field_help.limit_by_folders: Only export hosts whose target folder lies in these folders, e.g. /test. Recursive, so /test also covers /test/linux. Used to fill a test instance with part of the hosts.
account_custom_field_help.list_disabled_hosts: Set to True to list, at the end of an export, which hosts were left out because a rule disabled them.
account_custom_field_help.bakery_key_id: Number of the Checkmk signing key used to bake and sign agents. Needed together with bakery_passphrase.
account_custom_field_help.bakery_passphrase: Passphrase of the signing key named in bakery_key_id.
account_custom_field_help.dont_delete_hosts_if_more_then: Stop deleting hosts in Checkmk when a run would delete more than this many — a safety net against a broken import emptying the monitoring. The run reports the refusal as an error.
account_custom_field_help.dont_activate_changes_if_more_then: Do not activate changes when Checkmk has more pending changes than this, so a mass change is never activated unnoticed.
account_custom_field_help.wait_for_activate_changes: Set to True to wait until Checkmk has finished activating the changes, instead of only starting the activation and moving on.
account_custom_field_help.remove_orphaned_rules: Set to True to delete rules in Checkmk that the syncer created earlier but no rule of it produces any more. Only rules carrying this account's marker are touched.
account_custom_field_help.import_filter: Hosts whose name starts with one of these prefixes are not imported, comma separated.
